thesis.citation: Calza, A. (2026). A multiscale computational framework for the design and screening of graphene oxide in wastewater remediation. PhD thesis, University of Bologna.

locators.model_O_C_targets: Section 2.3, printed p. 23: computational model O/C ratios 0.43, 0.19, 0.07, 0.02 in product order.
locators.carboxylate_assumption: Section 2.3, printed p. 25: 90% of carboxyl groups are randomly converted to carboxylates as a modeling assumption.
locators.vacancy_protocol: Section 2.3, printed pp. 24-25: vacancy defects are introduced randomly using mixed-size defects, then dangling carbons are removed.

corrected_integer_recipe_table.description: Author-provided LayerOne XPS composition slide deck, slide 10, titled '4x4nm - corrected'. The source deck is not included in this repository.
corrected_integer_recipe_table.locator: Slide 10 table: carbon count and integer OH, epoxide, C=O, COOH, and COO- counts; vacancy labels are 10%, 5%, 2%, and 1%.
corrected_integer_recipe_table.interpretation_note: The table gives integer model recipes; this repository reuses those counts and records the author's model O/C targets. It does not infer a unique group recipe from XPS peak-area fractions or equate the model targets with manufacturer bulk composition.

GOX8-P935.public_product_claim: GOX8 Graphene Oxide P935 powder, -35 mesh.
GOX8-P935.datasheet_claim: P935 powder: carbon 64-65 wt%, oxygen 33-34 wt%, sulfur 1-2 wt%, nitrogen <1 wt%, chloride about 1 wt%, metals not detected; dry basis. The datasheet identifies P935 as <35 mesh and reports >99% GO crystalline phase.
GOX8-P935.code_warning: P935 is a product code associated with powder mesh, not evidence of 93.5% purity.

REGOX8-P980.public_product_claim: REGOX8 reduced graphene oxide powder labelled 80% C; product page does not state the percentage basis.

REGOX8-P995.public_product_claim: REGOX8 reduced graphene oxide powder labelled 95% C; product page does not state the percentage basis.

REGOX8-P999.public_product_claim: REGOX8 reduced graphene oxide powder labelled 99% C; product page does not state the percentage basis.

manufacturer_products.basis_note: These product/data-sheet claims are kept separate from the computational O/C targets and integer functional-group recipes. They are not converted into model recipes.
